conaf_original_download_reference: No consta en los CSV locales; calendario documentado y totales conciliados, cifras sin autenticación externa adicional.
conaf_variable: Cantidad de incendios registrados; no superficie quemada.

methods.anomaly: Observed minus calendar-month mean; 120 environmental months or 114 jointly matched months as appropriate.
methods.lag: Rain at t-k versus soil at t. Paired dates excluded when either falls in the omitted year; baseline recomputed without that year.
methods.omit_year_range: Sensitivity only, not a confidence interval or statistical significance test.
methods.within_month_rank: Pearson correlation of percent ranks calculated separately within each calendar month.
methods.spatial: Commune own baseline; soil masked below 80% coverage. Counts of communes are not independent pixels nor area fractions.

limitations: Ten-year descriptive baseline, not a long-term climate normal.
Temporal autocorrelation and shared source grids; no causal interpretation.
Cases selected after examining these same data.
Monthly environmental means cannot resolve daily fire weather.
Fire counts do not measure burned area or severity; AOD does not identify smoke origin.

fire_event_contrasts.observation_unit: One calendar month, entire Araucania region; not individual fire day/location.

fire_event_contrasts.activity_definition: Count >= 75th percentile within calendar month; only months with fire recorded in every observed year.
fire_event_contrasts.contrast_method: Difference of means within calendar month, then equal-weight average across eligible calendar months. Standardized difference divides each month difference by its own sample SD before averaging.
fire_event_contrasts.activity_omit_year_method: Recalculate count thresholds and groups after excluding each calendar year. Descriptive sensitivity, not a confidence interval.
limitations: Presence comparison is supported only in May-September, and without singleton groups only June-August.
Fire occurrence and high monthly activity answer different questions and compare different month populations.
Monthly regional variables cannot locate or describe ignition-day weather.
No fire causal attribution; shared grids, temporal dependence, potential reporting differences and omitted human/land-use factors.

event_context_output.concurrent_anomaly_reference: Calendar-month means over jointly observed months 2014-07/2023-12.
event_context_output.previous_month_anomaly_reference: Calendar-month means over full weather period 2014-01/2023-12, shifted by one month.

cohort_audit.group: Con incendios, fuera de ese contraste

inferential_followup.primary_model: NB2 count, log days offset, month fixed effects, centered linear time trend, four standardized within-month weather anomalies.
inferential_followup.formula: log(mu_t) = log(days_t) + calendar_month_FE + linear_time + heat + rain_deficit + rh_deficit + soil_deficit
inferential_followup.reference_months: 2014-07/2023-12, 114 consecutive months including 14 zeros; no activity-based exclusion.
inferential_followup.interpretation_of_soil_sensitivity: Positive association in primary linear-time model; year fixed effects CI includes 1, so independent contribution is sensitive to temporal control.
inferential_followup.multiplicity: Holm across four primary NB weather coefficients; Holm separately across six descriptive activity contrasts. CI95 marginal, not simultaneous.
limitations: Exploratory hypotheses after examining the same data; no independent confirmation.
Only 114 months; HAC normal inference is asymptotic and bandwidth-sensitive.
HAC handles covariance, not mean-model misspecification or confounding.
Group-contrast intervals condition on observed activity groups and their empirical thresholds.
Weather terms are associated and modeled linearly on log rate; no interaction or causal interpretation.
No population, land-use or reporting-effort offset is available; days are the only exposure offset.
The NB model describes counts, not individual ignition probability, burned area or forecasts.
